C0148.title: Gray market schemes in the ChatGPT boom: selling accounts and courses mostly gimmicks
C0148.summary: In May 2023, a media investigation found numerous merchants on e-commerce platforms and social groups selling ChatGPT accounts at prices ranging from 25 to 259 yuan. These account transactions carry fraud risks, with some buyers reporting accounts becoming invalid within a month, and some services being mirror sites run by resellers, posing risks of user privacy leakage.
